apps.name: AI-VJ
apps.short_description: Add mesmerizing AI visuals to your DJ shows. Liven up the big screen at house parties! Get perfect sync by linking up with all popular DJ software, or by using estimated beats per minute from any audio playing on your PC (such as Youtube or Spotify). Can even play your own VJ loops and VJ videos!

apps.name: CatTuber
apps.short_description: CatTuber can show your operation of keyboard, mouse and other devices with a cute virtual character. It can be used with live broadcast software such as OBS for game live broadcast, game video production, or simply placed on the computer screen as a decoration.

apps.name: Deep Desktop
apps.short_description: Deep Desktop brings a new dimension to your screen, images, videos and video games with generated depth. Enjoy your content in 3D with a VR headset, AR glasses or anaglyph glasses.

apps.name: Defold
apps.short_description: Defold is a free and open game engine used for development of desktop, mobile and web games.

apps.name: Desktop Overlays
apps.short_description: Put GIFs, stickers and widgets on your desktop or on top of your game. Frame your windows with glowing borders, make stickers move with your music and cut out backgrounds offline. Grab more from the Workshop or make your own. Light on your PC, so it just sits there and looks good.

apps.name: Desktop Terrarium: Companion Engine
apps.short_description: Bring your desktop to life with companions that move and react. Start with included content, create companions from your own artwork, and combine compatible characters, props, and behaviors. Configure reactions to supported desktop objects.

apps.name: Eltaros
apps.short_description: Create pixel-art RPG characters, portraits, and 100 animations. Sculpt and paint sprites, reshape and paint animation frames, then export for RPG Maker and Godot,Unity.

apps.name: Game Translation
apps.short_description: Understand game chat and write back in another language. Capture your saved chat region with a shortcut, read original messages beside their translations, then translate and copy your reply. Local OCR and translation are included, with optional support for your own external service.

apps.name: GameGuru MAX
apps.short_description: GameGuruMAX is designed to support the rapid development of a wide range of genres, from first-person shooters, and RPGs to puzzle games and narrative adventures. Included demo levels and templates help you learn the workflow and kickstart your projects with confidence.

apps.name: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number Digital Comic
apps.short_description: Download the Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number digital comic series by Dayjob Studio and dive into the backstory of several factions on a path to confrontation. The entire five-part series is free to download!

apps.name: Kenney Game Assets All-in-1
apps.short_description: Kenney Game Assets All-in-1 is the ultimate asset bundle with 60,000+ items including 2D sprites, 3D models, audio, UI, and fonts. Ready to use in any engine using open formats. Includes a powerful launcher and free updates!

apps.name: Movavi Video Editor 2026
apps.short_description:
Your simple yet powerful video editor turns gameplay into wow-worthy content easily. 

- Cut, crop, adjust speed, and clean things up with one-click tools like auto-subtitles and silence removal.
- Choose from hundreds of transitions, titles, filters, and overlays for epic gaming moments.

apps.name: N-LOG
apps.short_description: N-LOG runs anything on your screen through a simulated CRT TV: games, emulators, movies, anything.

apps.name: OverHue
apps.short_description: A facelift for the games you already own, plus colour-blind assist you can tune. OverHue smooths jagged edges and brings out texture detail live, drawn right on top of the game. It never touches the game's files or code, and it remembers your settings for each game.

apps.name: Pixelpart
apps.short_description: Visual effects for your game! Design animated effects in this particle-based editor and play them in your games. Use the game engine plugins or export effects to sprite sheets, image sequences and videos.

apps.name: PlayClaw 7
apps.short_description:
Use our cool in-game overlays to achieve the best gaming experience!
Harnessing the power of your GPU, hardware accelerated H.264 codecs and the various overlays, you will have an advantage over your opponents and you can share your victories.

apps.name: Screen Effect
apps.short_description: Add some cool effects to your screen!

apps.name: Sculptors
apps.short_description: Abstract art generator. Easily create sculptures, even without graphic design skills. You can build a gallery of your models and share it with other artists. VR support is included.

apps.name: Substance 3D Modeler 2025
apps.short_description: Adobe Substance 3D Modeler is an innovative sculpting and modeling app that aims at redefining how we create in 3D by combining VR and desktop experiences with a more natural approach to 3D modeling.

apps.name: Trayce
apps.short_description: Small live widgets on your Windows taskbar. Scroll over the strip to switch. Every widget closes while a full-screen game is in front. Make your own widget and share it on the Steam Workshop

apps.name: Untitled Telemetry App
apps.short_description: A telemetry tool for iRacing. Open your .ibt files, compare laps side by side with a time delta and ghost cars on the track map and see exactly where you gain or lose time. Runs fully on your PC. No account, no subscription.

apps.name: VConnect
apps.short_description:
VConnect is a stream overlay used to create on screen effects of all kind upon raids, subs, follows and more. 
With a Set-Up Wizard for less experienced users and an extensive Node System for power users, it's perfect to bring your ideas to life without the need to know coding!

apps.name: Visualization for Steam with Arduino
apps.short_description: Visualization for Steam with Arduino is a PC software and Arduino firmware package for players who want to build a custom faceplate for their Steam Machine or Steam gaming PC. External hardware required.

apps.name: Viztempo
apps.short_description: Make your Windows desktop feel alive with animated pets, music-reactive visualizers and a customizable system dashboard. Find your favorite look, keep an eye on your PC, and keep notes, reminders and everyday shortcuts close at hand.

apps.name: VTuber Maker
apps.short_description: VTuber Maker is the #1 free, simplistic, and 3D Tool for VTuber Content Production, just with a webcam.

apps.name: WallpaperLab
apps.short_description: WallpaperLab lets you bring your Windows desktop to life with animated wallpapers.

apps.name: (Don't) Hear Demo
apps.short_description: Responding to a late night call, a police officer discovers a hidden elevator in the woods leading to Resonance Laboratories. Trapped in a subterranean hell where sound experiments shattered reality, your only rule for survival is simple: (Don't) Hear

apps.name: 4 Ways to Die Demo
apps.short_description: Try a turn-based tower defense where every directional shot makes the enemies advance. Protect the temple, complete recipes, and transform your defenses. This demo includes a tutorial and three maps, with keyboard and mouse controls and French or English interface text.

apps.name: 8 Hours Till Dawn Demo
apps.short_description: In 8 Hours till dawn you and up to five friends draw 8 cards each round and decide how to Pre-program your Movements and Actions with those 8 cards. Find weapons, buy items, barricade windows, shoot the undead, manage your ammo, Navigate the woods, search the mall and most of all, survive the night

apps.name: A Game About Digging For Worms Demo
apps.short_description: BIG DEMO UPDATE! Stones in the ground, a pickaxe, a vacuum and ore. Dig the garden down to 15 meters, catch 7 kinds of worms and fill the sailor's order — 200 worms. Solo or with friends — CO-OP MULTIPLAYER. Free.

apps.name: Adapt Demo
apps.short_description: To survive, you must guide your species through a constantly changing world. Compete with strange creatures for food and territory, and find your niche through careful evolutionary choices. The real question is not if you can survive, but for how long.

apps.name: Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile - Demo
apps.short_description: Death on the Nile is an adventure-detective game, offering a fresh twist on Agatha Christie’s famous story. Set in the lively 1970s, play as Hercule Poirot and detective Jane Royce as they solve two connected mysteries. Dive into the first chapter in this demo!

apps.name: Alchemy Duel Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelike card game where you combine materials to alchemize monsters. Adapt to your enemies and your hand, and build powerful combos through card and relic synergies. Choose what to create and where to summon it—your decisions turn the tide of battle.

apps.name: All Army Attack Demo
apps.short_description: Get an exclusive early look at the action in All Army Attack with a brand new demo! Jump straight into the Prologue and brave the Arid Wastes across 6 escalating difficulty levels.

apps.name: Anomaly Inspector Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Papers, Please in an SCP-inspired setting. You are an agent of a secret anomaly control bureau. Analyze dangerous artifacts, run experiments, decide their fate. Complete your training over your first days at the bureau.

apps.name: Another Map Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

apps.name: Arcadium - Space Odyssey Demo
apps.short_description: Arcadium is a roguelite shooter set in a dynamically generated universe. Journey across space, harvest planetary resources, and craft powerful builds to eradicate relentless waves of aliens. Each playthrough unveils a new and uncharted universe, ensuring endless challenges and discoveries.

apps.name: Archemyst: Alchemy Shop Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental game of spell-driven gathering and alchemy shopkeeping. Summon skeletons and goblins, gather materials, craft goods and run your shop. Unlock recipes, expand the shop and follow the talent tree to relearn elemental magic and regain your powers as an archmage.

apps.name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix Demo
apps.short_description: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.

apps.name: Astro Burn Demo
apps.short_description: Dodge everything. Destroy anything. Stack ridiculous snack powers and unleash anime style Catnip powered chaos in this feel good fast paced cute-em-up. Play as Astro, a space cat with her robot companion on their journey home, battling through absurd enemies, deadly hazards, and unhinged bosses.

apps.name: Better at Gambling Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: a full 15-minute casino match with 4 minigames and every table, for 2 to 8 friends. Think you're the best gambler in your group? Prove it. The rest is waiting in the full version.

apps.name: Bob BOBBED Bob... Demo
developers: Adam and Simmons (Isaac Ward & Julian Ward)
publishers: Adam and Simmons (Julian Ward & Isaac Ward)

apps.name: Broken Shell Demo
apps.short_description: Broken Shell is a short, hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two hermit crabs searching for a place to call home. Explore a vibrant underwater world, solve gentle puzzles, and experience a heartfelt story told entirely without words.

apps.name: Burger Truck Demo
apps.short_description: Run a burger truck with a keyboard and mouse or in PC VR. Take orders, grill beef or chicken, and box up your first burgers. Both modes share 30 minutes of active play. Your saved kitchen carries into the full game on the same PC and Steam account.

apps.name: Cataclysm EscapeDemo
apps.short_description: Scavenge for resources in a collapsing post-apocalyptic world, evade monsters, and successfully extract before the darkness consumes everything. Death means losing all the items you carried out.

apps.name: Chinese Pancake Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Start with a humble pancake stand, purchase ingredients, cook pancakes, serve customers, and upgrade your equipment as you grow your business day by day.

apps.name: CODE.BREACH Demo
apps.short_description: I've been waiting for you. Beyond the high walls of London-1, millions fight to survive in the slums. Only one of them dreams of us. Guide him through a cyberpunk story of mercenary life, dark secrets and ha-- ...Hold on, this connection is unverified. Are you there?

apps.name: Conversation Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Try five real conversations — a job interview, a car negotiation, asking for a raise, a first ask, and Spanish at a café — with simulated characters who have their own agendas. Type or talk out loud: everything runs on your computer and works offline.

apps.name: COOKBOT Demo
apps.short_description: You've been placed as a standard pantry model COOKBOT on the pioneer ship Ruya. Your systems are malfunctioning. Cook, bake and pour while following recipes. The crew might talk to you. This is expected. Don't listen to them - you are just a machine.

apps.name: COSMIC HOLES Junior Demo
apps.short_description:
In this demo, discover the unique mechanics of “COSMIC HOLES Junior”.
“Aliens don't play Sudoku—they play COSMIC HOLES!”

apps.name: Crack of Strike Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first 6 shifts of Crack of Strike for free. Pick rough stones from sellers at the counter, control every strike and crack open gems from two suppliers. Take your finds home to cut and craft, and carry your progress into the full game.

apps.name: Crypt Survivor Demo
apps.short_description: Crypt Survivors is a dark fantasy survival roguelite where you battle endless demons inside a cursed crypt. Choose your class, survive brutal rooms, collect upgrades, defeat powerful bosses, and awaken ancient crystals to unlock new abilities.

apps.name: Crypto Trading Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Trade volatile crypto markets in real time, build automation bots, and upgrade your home-office into a capable trading setup. With bills rising and pressure mounting, every decision can push you toward profit or wipe you out.

apps.name: Curse of the Nether Regions Demo
apps.short_description: Culiebra, goddess of corruption and ruler of the Nether Regions, has broken free from her isolated domain and seeks revenge by plunging the mortal realms into darkness. Play as Minerva, a demi-goddess with dreams of heroism, as she tries to find her place and defeat the forces of darkness.

apps.name: Dadi Kingdom Demo
apps.short_description: Action RPG: You're the king. Everyone wants something from you, and you've got a sword. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse. Father an heir before your time runs out.

apps.name: Dance Dance Incremental Demo
apps.short_description: Hit incoming notes to collect bytes, then spend them to upgrade your device, build your army, and download new tracks. A rhythm incremental game inside your own Y2K mp3 player. Dance like it's the year 2000!

apps.name: Deadshot Demo
apps.short_description: You wake up as an army soldier in the middle of a mutant apocalypse, trying to figure out what the hell happened and blasting some heads on the way. Deadshot is a retro styled first person shooter inspired from classics like Half Life, Doom, Quake and many alike.

apps.name: Diaspora Protocol Demo
apps.short_description: A real-time space strategy game where your population is everything: it settles new worlds, mines your materials and crews every ship. Explore, expand and fight for the galaxy.

apps.name: Dicewood Demo
apps.short_description: A tiny pack of tiny creatures was lost in the woods. The food was scarce, they had to choose who will be left behind... Fight through the dark forest and save all the creatures.

apps.name: Do You Know Me? Demo
apps.short_description: How well do you really know your friends? Answer questions about each other, then survive 30+ chaotic co-op challenges. An online party game for 1–8 players that will make or break friendships.

apps.name: Dobbel Dungeon Demo
apps.short_description: Gather your party, roll your dice and battle across the islands to put an end to a powerful curse once and for all in this roguelike turn-based tactical RPG!

apps.name: DR. MATBEN Demo
apps.short_description: DR. MATBEN is an action-platformer roguelite where you customize your Modgun, explore simulations of your memories, and battle a rogue AI whose plan to save humanity could destroy it.

apps.name: Eldritch Descent X Demo
apps.short_description: Try Eldritch Descent X for free. Fight horror creatures, monsters and bosses in a dark descent and feel the atmosphere of the full game. The demo runs on the same combat and systems as the release; the full game continues with more levels and bosses.

apps.name: END US Demo
apps.short_description: In this ruined world, nothing good happens at midnight. We fight, we hunt, we build. We tear from the earth whatever is left, just to buy a few more moments of life. You arrived here believing you were the only one. Maybe you were wrong. Would this be the last night?

apps.name: Eventide Matter Demo
apps.short_description: A 2D space mining adventure. Mine asteroids, craft components, and defend your work from relentless enemies as you build a mysterious structure in an unknown universe.

apps.name: Fakutori Demo
apps.short_description: Fakutori is a laid-back automation game with a lot more going on beneath the surface. Combine elements, build sprawling production lines, and chase down the Legendary Blocks that only the most dedicated builders ever find. All at your own pace.

apps.name: Farm The Swarm Demo
apps.short_description: Farm The Swarm is a roguelite tower defence game where tens of thousands of aliens pour down the lanes at once. Build turrets, stack items and snowball into absurd builds, then see how long you last against the endless swarm!

apps.name: Farmstead Market Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Build your farm and roadside market in this farming and shop management demo. Grow crops, care for farm animals, craft products, stock your shelves, and set prices. Serve customers and reinvest your earnings to develop your business.

apps.name: Fever Tilt Demo
apps.short_description: The free Fever Tilt demo: full 1v1 Versus and solo Time Trial in a ruthless zero-G arena sport. Mine gems, weaponize debris, and sabotage your rival with lasers, forcefields, and explosives - first to 5 goals wins. Wishlist the full game for Tournament mode and the November 2026 launch.

apps.name: Finding Buddies Demo
apps.short_description: Finding Buddies is a romance visual novel where your dialogue choices shape Daniel’s story and relationships. Explore different scenes, meet new characters, and experience a narrative with interactive gameplay moments.

apps.name: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop Demo
Flash The Floppy Fish Demo
apps.short_description: Master the art of fast flopping and exploit deep fish physics as you speed through handcrafted environments and rank up to beat your and your friends' times. Can you claim the title of "Flash the Floppy Fish"? Or are you just another stale sardine?

apps.name: Flesh Blossom Demo
apps.short_description: Play as Doctor Parsnip Green, treating horrifically beautiful illnesses in this Victorian-inspired investigative point-and-click. How far will you go to save the ones you love — and who will still trust you when your sanity begins to crack?

apps.name: Fleshinsane Demo
apps.short_description: Fight and destroy armed creatures in the name of inquisition and security on the ancient ark ship, use and combine melee and ranged attacks to destroy all life in a bewitching top-down shooter pixel art rogue-like!

apps.name: Following Seas Demo
apps.short_description:
The Following Seas demo gives you a scaled down area of the game's world.

Freely sail between four islands and landmarks on the caravel.

Fish, transport cargo, explore, battle the wind and waves, and experience the wonder of dying alone at sea.

apps.name: Furei - Journey of Two Spirits Demo
Garden Cleaner: Cozy Grass Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Pull the overgrown Backyard clean blade by blade, sell your harvest and upgrade your tools in this free demo of a calm, cozy first-person yard cleaning game.

apps.name: Garden Souls Demo
apps.short_description: Garden Souls is a 2D action roguelite focused on fast combat, stylish combos and build crafting. Choose one of the four Garden Princesses, unlock new strikes, combine elements and adapt your combat style each run to face corrupted floral biomes and stop the Mandragora.

apps.name: Grass Planet Demo
apps.short_description: Stranded on an alien planet, you must mow the endless grassy hills to uncover the materials needed to rebuild your ship. Upgrade your lawnmower and uncover the mystery of the planet in this short incremental adventure.

apps.name: Grid Forge TD Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental, path building, tower defense game. Construct your maze by placing tetronimoes and give your towers more time to destroy the enemy. Use the research points earned each run to level up and get even more powerful.

apps.name: Harbourlight Demo
apps.short_description: Seven days at the counter of a tiny diner that's gonna help wake the town. Develop your farm and chef skills by day, then cook for one guest a night and work out what they're really hungry for. Meet five locals, take orders over the phone and start turning all the lights back on.

apps.name: Heroic Gambit Demo
apps.short_description: Heroic Gambit is an action roguelite set in the fantastic world of Nemia. Navigate the randomly generated dungeons, through progressively more challenging foes, traps and riddles of the Founders. Good reflexes and solid strategy are required to reach your ultimate goal.

apps.name: IDLE_DIRECTIVE Demo
apps.short_description: Idly gather and manage resources to repair what's left of a decaying world. Scavenge forgotten ruins, meet scattered survivors, and push back against the inevitable collapse. IDLE_DIRECTIVE is a grid-based inventory and resource management idle game.

apps.name: Imperialist Demo
apps.short_description: From a veteran 4X developer comes a game of logistics, trade and empire. Lead one of seven European powers from 1500 to 1950: explore the New World, ship its wealth home, industrialise your Capital, and hold an empire that wants to break free. Can you exploit the New World to control the Old?

apps.name: In Banjiha Demo
apps.short_description: It is a first-person horror game. Escape the damp, dark semi-basement. Overcome your fear and find a way out.

apps.name: Infinite Night 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Play Kael's first stage for free in this single-player demo. Evade the surrounding horde, break out with well-timed skills, test gear, orbs, and mastery nodes, and challenge the stage's mid-boss and final boss.

apps.name: Lattice Defense Demo
apps.short_description: A tower defense game meets top-down shooter. Build a maze of walls and elemental towers by day. Defend yourself by night. Dash, build, and blast your way until dawn. Play solo or in online co-op.

apps.name: Learn Japanese RPG: Hiragana Forbidden Speech Demo
apps.short_description: Dialogue changes from English to Japanese as you learn and progress in this comedic RPG backed by professional Japanese voice acting.   Master reading hiragana and over 240 common words used in anime!

apps.name: Legacy of Sail Demo
apps.short_description: As a 17th Century Admiral, send your squadrons out to capture enemy towns and sink their ships. Force boarding actions to capture their prized Ships of the Line all while balancing the need for supplies, repairs and upgrading your crew in this throwback real time tactics naval combat game

apps.name: Lich Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person, grid-based dungeon crawler powered by full D&D 5th Edition rules. Lead a party of four through one level of a gothic dungeon in turn-based combat against the undead, in this demo for The Lich - A Dungeon of Despair, releasing December 2026.

apps.name: LunaGenesis Demo
apps.short_description: Enter the dreams of a plague-stricken rat town to uncover what its theocratic rulers are hiding in this single-player psychological horror adventure.

apps.name: Lurking Demo
apps.short_description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

apps.name: Maiden Cards Demo
apps.short_description: Build custom decks from a persistent collection of over 100 hand-drawn cards. Win tactical battles, complete challenges, and unlock new cards in this adult single-player fantasy card battler with no microtransactions.

apps.name: Marschwerk: Tug of War Strategy Demo
Meltdown Acres Demo
apps.short_description: Try the opening of Meltdown Acres, a dark comedy farming game. Clear the farm, grow your first strange vegetables and sell them to your first two customers. Play as long as you like; your farm carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Meow Cards Demo
apps.short_description: Meow Cards is a cat-themed strategic card game. Collect feline cards with unique abilities, build your very own Meow Cards deck, and climb to the top—together with your cats! Meow～

apps.name: Miner Rogue Demo
apps.short_description: In a fully destructible world, gather resources, build, and craft items. Fight back with your friends against the corruption spreading across the land. But don't dig too deep, because you might end up in hell.

apps.name: Mining to Riches! Demo
apps.short_description: Try the Mining to Riches! demo. Drop medals, push miners and pickaxes over the edge, and turn the ore your crew digs up into more medals.

apps.name: Modan's Book of Myths: The Nameless Knight Demo
apps.short_description: Fill the boots of the Nameless Knight in this demo of a dark fairytale turn-based RPG, and liberate Haven from evil forces both supernatural and humanoid in nature!

apps.name: Monster League Baseball Demo
apps.short_description: In Monster League Baseball, manage a team of creatures and critters by optimizing your layout, upgrading stats, and slugging out to score as many runs as possible. Monster League Baseball puts YOU in control of your own team of nine.

apps.name: Mortal Shell II - Open Beta
apps.short_description: Step into the ravaged world of Mortal Shell II and begin the Harbinger’s journey. Play the opening three hours of the game in this limited Open Beta, with select progress carrying forward into the full release.

apps.name: Murazu 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Dash, rocket-launch, and shave milliseconds off your time in a precision platformer with instant restarts. Chase gold times and race against the global leaderboards.

apps.name: My Hockey Story Demo
apps.short_description: Play Season 1 of My Hockey Story for free. Train a young hockey player, learn tactics with your coach, and make quick decisions during matches. Develop your skills through training drills, mini-games, and your first season of competition.

apps.name: Newtone's Gospel Demo
apps.short_description: Newtone's Gospel is a top-down roguelike shooter. Unlike typical Survivors-likes, it is more about exploring huge procedurally generated maps, planning your route, turning limited resources into more resources and finally into increasingly powerful builds.

apps.name: Night Glass: One More Tide Demo
NitorInc.: Touhou Microgames! DEMO+
apps.short_description: An ongoing, collaborative Touhou Project fan game full of rapid-fire microgames YOU can help make! Nitori Kawashiro has brought video games to the fantasy world of Gensokyo, and she intends to capitalize on it with as many diverse games as possible, so you'd better think fast!

apps.name: Object 17 Demo
apps.short_description: Object 17 - is a puzzle game. This is a real test of your mental abilities. The main skill you will need is abstract thinking.

apps.name: Odd Rock Out Demo
apps.short_description: One quiet afternoon, five thousand pebbles, and no idea where you left the key. Pick them up, shake them by your ear, and get delightfully distracted. No upgrades, no rush: try the first 35 minutes of Odd Rock Out, alone or in online co-op with up to four friends.

apps.name: Orbit Foundry Demo
apps.short_description: Build a fleet of tiny machines around a growing star. Buy facilities, research with Alloy, and collect Star Cores through Reforge without losing your fleet. Chase optional Overdrives, automate production, and start a new life with Stellar Legacy.

apps.name: Pasture: The Livestock Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Do you have what it takes to be a cattle farmer?   Muster and manage thousands of cattle in the rugged Australian Outback, solo or with some mates in this demo.

apps.name: Penknife Demo
apps.short_description: he closer to death you are the stronger you become, Penknife is a Survival Horror where a British chav accidentally unleashes an eldritch invasion. Fight to survive with limited resources within an open, interconnected world, infested with horrifying monsters.

apps.name: Picky Numbers Demo
apps.short_description: Picky Numbers is a calm incremental/idle game based on lottery mechanics. Buy tickets, choose numbers, and watch as the drum draws results one by one. The more numbers you hit, the bigger the payout. Each ticket is a different strategy, with higher risk and higher reward, or a JACKPOT.

apps.name: PIGFACE Demo
apps.short_description: You wake up with an explosive headache in a pool of your own blood. You're Exit, a terrible woman whose awful past has finally caught up to her. Fulfill contracts for the people who drilled into your skull — guns-blazing, slow and tactical — it doesn’t matter. They know you’ll do whatever it takes.

apps.name: Pixel Platoons Demo
apps.short_description: **Play the free demo!** Command your squad in retro-inspired, top-down military action where every soldier matters and every loss is permanent. Fight, survive, earn promotions and build your platoon. Classic 16-bit action meets persistent progression and lasting consequences.

apps.name: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED: the first three nights of the shift. Bodies arrive with paperwork, and the paperwork has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

apps.name: Police Chief Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of the full Police Chief Simulator game takes you to Winston Springs Police Station! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

Keep it Strange with this Cosmetic Pack celebrating the Weird Wild West; your enemies won't know if you're coming or going! This pack includes: 
• Double-fronted Hollybird car 
• Four-sided Cowboy Hat 
• Two-sided Cowboy Boots

apps.name: Saints Row - Going Commando Cosmetic Pack
apps.short_description:
Steal in style with a new Commando Boss outfit and tactical weapon, and give those explosive heists a touch of class! This pack includes: 
• Commando Shotgun with flashlight 
• Commando Turtleneck 
• Commando Backpack 
• Commando Pants 
• Commando Hightop Shoes

apps.name: Sill Cats - Basic Toy Pack
apps.short_description: Give your cats some toys. More types of toys are planned for the future. Try placing a rolling ball that cats love, a flag with a cute design, or a cat tower that makes it easier for them to climb up high on your screen.

apps.name: SRX: The Game - Short Track Asphalt Pack
apps.short_description: Add the Super Late Model and 6 new asphalt tracks to SRX: The Game!

apps.name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Autumn 2020
apps.short_description: Beautiful autumn pictures

apps.name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Second Anniversary
apps.short_description: Great images to celebrate the second anniversary of Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations!

apps.name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Summer 2020
apps.short_description: Great images to say good bye to Summer 2020

apps.name: Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia
apps.short_description: Embark on a royal journey in Suzerain's first DLC. Embrace the crown as King Romus Toras, and lead the Golden Kingdom to a new era. Reclaim lost territories through diplomacy or force. Engage with royal houses and oversee the resources of Rizia. How will you reign?

apps.name: SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada - Season 4 Additional Content Pack
apps.short_description: This Additional Content Pack grants access to the new Intermission scenario content, a paid Item Warehouse expansion, and CRADLECOFFIN and weapon crafting recipes.

apps.name: The Emperor and State - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: If you enjoy The Emperor and State and wish to support the continued development of the game, then this Supporter Pack is perfect for you.

apps.name: The Forever Winter - Fleshwraps Skin Pack
apps.short_description:
The Forever Winter Fleshwraps Skin Pack includes:

The Teddystuffa for Gunhead
The Filtermund Skin for Maskman
The Smoghide Skin for Old Man

apps.name: Tower Dominion - Art Book
apps.short_description: This official digital book is your ultimate companion to the merciless trenches of the galactic war against the Artronid invaders.

apps.name: Train Sim World® 6: Avanti West Coast BR Class 805 Evero BMU Add-On
apps.short_description: Race your way along West Coast Main Line in Avanti West Coast’s Class 805 Evero! From accelerating out of Euston to whizzing through the Staffordshire curves, all-new & modern bi-mode action awaits in Train Sim World, courtesy of All Aboard Studios.

apps.name: Train Simulator: Clear Creek Log & Lumber Expansion Pack Add-On
Tulpa - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Red Aura's soundtrack for Tulpa in full, ten wallpapers of its four worlds and a 28-page artbook. Tulpa is free, and this pack is a way to support the people who made it. It adds nothing to the game itself.

apps.name: Twilight Requiem Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Support the development of Twilight Requiem with this exclusive digital bonus collection. Includes 7 original soundtrack pieces and 9 high-resolution art assets from the game's creation.

apps.name: War Thunder - German Fiat G.91 R/4 Pack
War Thunder - Italian Starter Pack
apps.short_description: The premium M14/41 (47/40) light tank, the Re.2001 fighter, 7 days of Premium account and Silver Lions - a starter pack for legionnaires in War Thunder!

apps.name: World War Z: Raven Weapons Skin Pack
apps.short_description: Add unique flair to your zombie slaying arsenal with the Raven Weapon Skins Pack, featuring 4 premium raven-themed skins, one for each weapon.

apps.name: 100 Lives
apps.short_description: Live 100 lives. Shape an entire world. Become a god. In this narrative roguelike life sim, every life shapes the next. Become anyone you imagine: build careers, fall in love, make friends, enemies and questionable choices across Kingstown. Restore the Tree of Life as you progress toward godhood.

apps.name: 11 Seconds
apps.short_description: Slide around through puzzle chambers, escaping down to the next floor. Push boxes out of your way. Maybe they can help you. But there's not a lot of time... you need more time!

apps.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
apps.short_description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

apps.name: 360Hexaworld
apps.short_description: Another world 360Hexaworld is a Web 3.0 metaverse world platform

apps.name: A Perfect Location
apps.short_description: Southern Italy, 1990s. You're a photographer scouting locations for low-budget horror movies. Drive along country roads, through woods and hairpin turns. Explore abandoned places on foot. Frame and take the shot. There's no one to meet and nothing to run from. You'll find out why.

apps.name: Abyss Breakers
apps.short_description: A hack-and-slash action RPG played in 60-second hunts. Cut through the horde and get out with the loot before the dark closes in. Back at camp, build around what you found, with random gear and a passive tree of over 1,000 nodes. Four classes, 100 Depths.

apps.name: Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro
apps.short_description: Unlock 100 achievements as you smash targets, reduce their health, and upgrade your hammer! Keep clicking, get stronger, and collect them all in Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro!

apps.name: Afterground: The Children
apps.short_description: The world ended. The road home didn't. Fight through ever-changing ruins, build your power one card at a time, and rescue survivors on a journey from grasslands through desert to frozen wastes. A post-apocalyptic action roguelite where every night could be the last.

apps.name: AI Lab Tycoon
apps.short_description: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?

apps.name: Aikyam
apps.short_description: Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!

apps.name: ALPENGLIDE
apps.short_description: Glide down an endless, ever-changing mountain range as a wind spirit lost in alpine peaks. Graze cliffs and dive through canyons to build up your multiplier, survive the fog and snow, and race to the top of the daily and all-time leaderboards.

apps.name: Alpha Spectrum
apps.short_description: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where humanity is dangerously dependent on technology and social media. You are a CIA agent with psionic powers sent to investigate a devastating cyberattack that throws the world into chaos. But the system you trust may crack from within...

apps.name: Angelfall
apps.short_description: Face the endless armies of Light and become the nightmare they fear! Angelfall is a roguelike reverse-horror game, in which you play as powerful Archdemon, slaughter hordes of humans, harvest their souls, and discover devastating synergies. Grow stronger, unlock new powers, and conquer the Light.

apps.name: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest
apps.short_description: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest is a classic point-and-click adventure packed with humor, puzzles, and unforgettable characters. It’s the sequel to Angelo and Deemon: One Hell of a Quest — and things are about to get heavenly chaotic.

apps.name: Animetal Menagerie
apps.short_description: In this roguelike tower defense, explore the remnants of an ancient biological preserve! Build an army of animal-machine hybrids and collect ancient artifacts from across the multiverse to fight against the ancient experiments left to rot, while the station crumbles around you.

apps.name: Another Map Simulator
apps.short_description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

apps.name: Anvil Flow
apps.short_description: Run your own forge in this incremental blacksmithing game. Mine ore, smelt ingots, forge weapons, and sell them to customers. Reinvest your earnings in workers and upgrades, and turn a one-person workshop into an automated production line.

apps.name: Apartment 3 | شقة 3
apps.short_description: You are Yasser. Your friend Abdullah asked for help checking an apartment, and you said no. Past midnight, his message arrives: he needs help. An Arabic horror game with full Arabic voice-over and English subtitles: explore, solve puzzles, survive the chase. Two endings.

apps.name: Archemyst: Alchemy Shop
apps.short_description: An incremental game of spell-driven gathering and alchemy shopkeeping. Summon skeletons and goblins, gather materials, craft goods and run your shop. Unlock recipes, expand the shop and follow the talent tree to relearn elemental magic and regain your powers as an archmage.

apps.name: Ardenfall
apps.short_description: Inspired by classic The Elder Scrolls games, Ardenfall is a first-person, open-world RPG of ancient cultures and rival factions. Explore windswept plains and forgotten dungeons, forge your path with steel, magic, or persuasion, and shape the fate of those you meet.

apps.name: Armoured Combat
apps.short_description: A turn-based strategy game featuring WWII armored vehicles.  Deploy historical vehicles from the four major factions. Play through missions, explore the maps to locate enemy armor, launch attacks, and attempt to capture enemy objectives while defending your own.

apps.name: ARROW ARROW BROKEN
apps.short_description: ARROW ARROW BROKEN is a puzzle game with a typing twist. The rules are the puzzle game you already know, except you must correctly type the arrow written on each block. Get one wrong... and madness will come for you.

apps.name: ART NOIRE: Christmas
apps.short_description: ART NOIRE: Christmas: a relaxing, atmospheric ring puzzle game celebrating Christmas in cities around the world. Rotate concentric rings in 50 picture puzzles. Enjoy festive film noir art, soothing music, and a shift from black and white to full color. Play solo with a mouse.

apps.name: ASCII Realms
apps.short_description: A free-to-play online fantasy RPG drawn entirely in ASCII. Explore on horseback, battle monsters with real-time spells and steel, collect loot, and upgrade your equipment at the forge. Develop your character in a shared world.

apps.name: Ashen of Thrones
apps.short_description: When the thrones of men crumble to ash, only Gods and Titans claim the earth. Ashen of Thrones is a visceral 2D RTS featuring intense lane-based combat, mythological evolution, active divine magic, and monumental Titan battles. Command your army and survive the campaign.

apps.name: Ashen Rain
apps.short_description: No justice. Only consequences. Ashen Rain is a brutal 2.5D tactical action shooter: fight through rain-soaked streets, factories and military outposts with weighty gunplay, punishing enemy fire and visceral, realistic damage. The law failed. He didn't.

apps.name: Ass Slapper Co
apps.short_description: Ass Slapper Co. is a desktop companion game where real-world typing and well-timed slaps earn Employee Fulfillment. Upgrade and customize your workplace as eccentric founder Johan Slapper guides you through a 6-chapter storyline from a 2D closet to a 3D penthouse office.

apps.name: Astral Planes
apps.short_description: Astral Planes is a psychedelic music puzzler with many solutions. Carve through cosmic dust, chase musical discoveries, and collect notes to build evolving compositions. Every trip transforms the world around you, and every completed performance leaves behind a record of how you played.

apps.name: Astrodescent
apps.short_description: Mine the stars. Build your empire. CONSUME THE GALAXY. Astrodescent is a 2D mining incremental game where you dig through worlds, harvest rare materials, and upgrade your gear to unstoppable levels

apps.name: AstroDiner Manager
apps.short_description: Become a manager for your own diner on a lonely asteroid. Order snacks and drinks, cook dishes, and serve them to quirky alien slimes. Talk, hire, investigate, and keep an eye on the visitors to reveal the hidden mystery behind this place.

apps.name: Astroventure: Unchartred Planet
apps.short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey as Sophia, a brave heroine searching for her lost friend Olga. Explore uncharted worlds, encounter diverse races, and unravel cosmic mysteries. Will you find Olga amidst the depths of space? Battle enemies, solve puzzles, and unlock new realms in this captivating adventure

apps.name: Backpack Guardian
apps.short_description: Backpack Guardian is an action roguelike where your inventory is your build. Rotate and arrange weapons, armor, spells, relics, blessings, and cursed loot to trigger synergies, stack multipliers, and survive three Acts of fast-paced combat.

apps.name: Bad Ice Cream Triple Scoop
apps.short_description: The Ice Creams are BACK! Our legendary arcade classic with over 100M plays is remastered in the ultimate collection. Break ice, outsmart bizarre monsters, and scoop up a victory in a frantic dash for fruit. Remodeled with epic boss battles, new flavors, and 1-4 player co-op!

apps.name: BAJAMAR
apps.short_description: BAJAMAR is a first-person point-and-click mystery adventure on an abandoned lighthouse island. Explore, examine everything, combine what you find and solve logical puzzles to follow the trail your brother left for you alone. No combat. No hand-holding.

apps.name: Bamboo Beat
apps.short_description: Embark on a journey through the world of Bamboo Beat. Attack, block, and counter to the beat, and take down one formidable foe after another.

apps.name: Bankster
apps.short_description: Embark on high-stakes heists in Bankster, a multiplayer strategy game. Outwit undercover feds, plan and execute heists, and escape with the loot. Customize vaults, face NPC police, and experience intense, tactical gameplay in dynamic environments. Beware—one of you might be a saboteur!

apps.name: Barely Civilized
apps.short_description: Build a floating home, craft a seaplane, and explore an open-world survival crafting sandbox alone or with friends. Tow your workshop and garden across the water to a new coast, fish for dinner, and prepare for winter. Watch your back after dark.

apps.name: Battle for Noalea
apps.short_description: Battle for Noalea is a turn-based fantasy wargame for two players. Lead one of four factions and its hero, seize settlements and outmaneuver your rival in battles without dice and without hidden information. Play against real people online via Steam or in hotseat mode on one screen.

apps.name: BE2
apps.short_description: BE2 is a 2d Jump and run game. the goal in this game is too reach the flag but be careful there can be monster and other  creatures but not that there also exiting levels awaiting for you.

apps.name: Bermuda Bastion
apps.short_description: Survive 33 days in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle! Build triangular structures to defend against malevolent squares, pentagons, and other geometric monsters. In this chaotic city-builder roguelike, every mistake pulls your Bastion closer to the depths.

apps.name: Better at Gambling
apps.short_description: Think you're the best gambler in your friend group? Prove it. Hit the tables, survive the minigames, and if luck runs out, just take the chips from whoever's in the lead. In the end, only one of you is better at gambling.

apps.name: Beyond the Curtains
apps.short_description: "Beyond the Curtains" is a cozy idle game. Watch a town, train journey, or graveyard through a window. Click to interact, press "nap" to move time, or simply observe. No tutorials, no goals—witness changes across three themes and piece together their stories.

apps.name: Bionic Tadpole
apps.short_description:
A run-n-gun, non-stop action platformer-shooter! Pick up a weapon. A jetpack. 
A force shield. All while evading bullet-hell madness! Oh, and be mindful not to let your gun overheat...

apps.name: BitLoaf
apps.short_description: Little 3D Loafs live on your Windows desktop. They wander, react to you, hang out with each other, and find their own fun while you work. Even secret characters! With more to come with updates.

apps.name: Black Dawn Rises
apps.short_description: The action game where you write the orders. Sign tomorrow's order as written or change it, then fight the mission your choice made: free-flow combat, a whip that binds, and Iona Sorn at your side. Since 1947, secret files have said what happens next. Arena co-op for two, on one couch or online.

apps.name: Blackest Friday
apps.short_description: Black Friday night, and the shoppers turned. Drive straight into the zombie crowd: back-to-back roadkills build a RAM combo, long drifts end in a TURBO. Turn loyalty points into coupons and survive until closing time.

apps.name: BlackHole Defence
apps.short_description: You are the black hole. Pull in matter, gain mass and grow while your attacks keep the battlefield moving. Turn a small singularity into the centre of a cosmic battle.

apps.name: Blackwood Abattoir
apps.short_description: Blackwood Abattoir is a first-person psychological horror game where an unkillable, 100% blind monster hunts you purely by sound. Trapped in a dark slaughterhouse with no weapons, every footstep, flashlight click, and breath could be your last. Stay silent, or become cattle.

apps.name: Blast_Mining_Puzzle
apps.short_description:
Swap bombs, match three, and dig deep underground in this match-3 mining puzzle. 
Sell ores, upgrade your bombs, and keep digging — many more upgrade systems lie buried in the depths.

apps.name: Bless You Again
apps.short_description: Lily is a magician and a homunculus who braves a perilous dungeon in search of the Philosopher's Stone. Control a character faithfully reproduced from cel animation and defeat countless monsters in pursuit of powerful blessings. Use blessings, skills, and gimmicks to forge a strength of your own!

apps.name: Block Party Apocalypse
apps.short_description: A blocky third-person zombie shooter for 1–4 players. Fight 30 waves across three days of the outbreak, stack upgrade cards, grab miniguns and flamethrowers from supply drops, and reach the last evacuation helicopter out of Port Haven.

apps.name: Bloodrust
apps.short_description: Bloodrust is a minimalist, old-school first-person dungeon crawler. Lead a party of four Ferric Wardens into the Ashwoods to clear the Blood Rust; a curse that spreads through metal and turns the world wrong.

apps.name: Blux
apps.short_description: Engage in a non epic adventure of slimy goodness - Shoot, loot and level up your skills! Create your own weapons and play style by combining the heck out of all these skills we were too lazy to balance properly.

apps.name: Boat Trip
apps.short_description: Pilot your boat through swarming schools of fish in this naval action roguelite. Combine weapons, upgrade your ship and face colossal bosses, solo or in 1~4 online co-op.

apps.name: BogKnight
apps.short_description: A broken sword, a talking raven, and a city preserved beneath the mist. Explore a nonlinear dark fantasy action-adventure of wraiths, swordplay, and strange magic. Find your own way through the bog.

apps.name: Boingdom!
apps.short_description: One ball. One kick. Then… everything. Boingdom! is a pixel bouncing-ball clicker: kick balls right before they land for PERFECT bounces, build a robot army, unlock 11 wild ball types and 10 table themes, and Rebound your way to THE BIG BOING.

apps.name: Bonk Bonanza
apps.short_description: An online party game for up to 8 players. Your host Glimmer runs a game show that makes no sense, and you and your friends are the contestants. Fight on spinning plates, bid on mystery containers, have naval battles in pirate ships, draw awful doodles and race mine carts through 50+ minigames.

apps.name: Booba Milk Tea
apps.short_description: An unique dual deckbuilding sex battle roguelite. Build two decks, a normal deck and a lust deck. As your Lust rises you start drawing more cards from your more powerful lust deck. But pace yourself! If the lust deck runs out it's game over!

apps.name: Boxing Tycoon
apps.short_description: Run your own boxing promotion. Scout and sign fighters, negotiate every contract, face the press, build fight cards and beat rival promoters to the biggest nights. Watch your fighters go to war in full 3D and turn them into world champions.

apps.name: BRAZUELA
apps.short_description: Start from nothing and build your own path in Brazuela, a political and life simulator set in Brazil. Work, study, join a political party, run for office, win positions of power, and take part in the decisions that shape a city.

apps.name: Brickrium
apps.short_description: Keep watering one brick on a window shelf and watch. Droplets bead up, run down and pool in the dish as moss, small yellow flowers, ferns and mushrooms slowly grow. Outside, the hour and weather change and rain runs down the glass. No winning, score or timer. Time passes while the game is closed.

apps.name: Broke2Blocks: Crypto Mining Simulator
apps.short_description: Start in your parents' basement with a single USB stick miner. Plug in every cable yourself and sell your coins. Move into an old gym, then into a huge warehouse full of racks. Buy broken miners on the black market, fix them screw by screw and keep the heat under control.

apps.name: Bunny Beats
apps.short_description: Bunny Beats is a listening first rhythm learning game with procedurally generated rhythms. Each bunny swings its mochi hammer with a distinct rhythm; master the rhythms on the fly to make the best mochi for the moon goddess!

apps.name: Campaign Season
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactical board game that sees the player take on the role of an Officer in the Empire's army, recruit Soldiers, lead them on Campaign, and command them in battle.

apps.name: Cannon Keep
apps.short_description: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

apps.name: CANON CANON CANON
apps.short_description: Stack cannons on your units, chain their effects and hold the line! A roguelite lane defense where every run is different.

apps.name: Capybara Clash
apps.short_description: These Capybaras are armed to the teeth and eager to unleash destruction on both their enemies and the environment, with a huge arsenal of fun but deadly weapons. Blow it all up online, alone or in local multiplayer.

apps.name: Carnival Stand Simulator
apps.short_description: Grill it. Load it. Hand it over. Carnival Stand Simulator drops you behind the counter of a midway hot dog stand where the line never really ends. Serve fast, sell out, and build the busiest pitch at the fair.

apps.name: Carouspell
apps.short_description: Carouspell is a dark fantasy roguelite bullet heaven where you wield revolving magic to slay hordes of monsters. Spin your Spell Chamber, collect ancient relics and assemble god-slaying combinations to survive the deepest pits of despair.

apps.name: Carry Crew
apps.short_description: "There’s room for one more!" Pick your cargo, pile it onto a board, and grab opposite ends in this couch co-op adventure for two. When the ice cracks underfoot, jump together on three. You both made it across. Did your cargo?

apps.name: Carry On, Idiots
apps.short_description: Haul awkward cargo, toss each other around, and try to keep the damage down. Carry On, Idiots is a chaotic 2D physics game for one or two players with online co-op. Earn money, buy tools, and salvage your delivery company's reputation. Great plan. Then you picked it up.

apps.name: Castles Of War
apps.short_description: A side-scrolling real-time strategy game of conquest, courage, and creation. Raise armies, command formations, and fight across hand-crafted pixel battlefields in a war-torn fantasy world.

apps.name: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm
apps.short_description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

apps.name: Champions City
apps.short_description: Build the life you can’t have in reality: make money 💸, meet new people 🤝, upgrade your lifestyle ✨, and rise to the top of Champions City 🌆.

apps.name: Chess Nuke
apps.short_description: This is NOT a Chess, don't aim to CHECKMATE, but focus on MERGING the pieces to become a NUCLEAR BOMB

apps.name: CHEW YOUR FOOD
apps.short_description: It didn't chew you properly. Escape its stomach by crawling, solving puzzles, listening carefully, and avoiding monsters in this survival horror.

apps.name: CHI Project
apps.short_description: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel, turn-based RPG, and murder mystery -- all in one!

apps.name: Chronos Arena
apps.short_description: Heavy armor meets modern ballistics: Battle it out in fast-paced 2D top-down PvP arena matches deep inside the dungeon. Upgrade your arsenal with modular attachments, stack devastating blessings, and master skill-based gunplay to dominate your enemies.

apps.name: Clarity's Calling
apps.short_description: Uncover your deepest ambitions in CLARITY'S CALLING, a narrative-driven puzzle game. Navigate dimly lit mazes and solve slide puzzles to lead Claire through her journey of self-discovery.

apps.name: Clean Record
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person cleanup sim on a deep space mining station. A generator blew and scattered crystals through every compartment. Sweep, blow and vacuum them up, buy better tools, and read the notes left behind. Find out what happened to the crew, and decide how their story ends.

apps.name: Coaches Box 27
apps.short_description: Take charge of an Australian rules football club. Trade, draft and game plan your way to a premiership. Make tactical changes from the box, manage your squad and make the hard decisions to build your dynasty. Play singleplayer or multiplayer with up to 8 friends.

apps.name: Come Pick Me Up
apps.short_description: Your sister texts you from a hospital after visiting hours. She needs you to pick her up. Search the wards, follow her messages, examine belongings and piece together unsettling records in this first-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: Conversation Simulator
apps.short_description: Conversation Simulator is the practice tool for interviews, negotiations, difficult talks, and language skills. AI characters run entirely on your computer. No internet needed during play. Open source, fairly priced.

apps.name: Cool Bandit
apps.short_description: Explore the shifting depths of Grenopolis in this stylized 2D top-down action shooter. Face relentless zombie hordes, manage high-tension progression, and team up in intense online co-op to survive together in an underground world that constantly evolves.

apps.name: CooM
apps.short_description:
CooM is a 30-Map, Gory, boobie-filled, Boomer-Shooter Action-RPG. It has 65 enemies and 8 player stats to upgrade.
There are 13 base enemy types, and each base has 5 tiers. You can buy weapons in your sanctuary and ammo for each, like the Schluger, a modest beating-organ-affixed handgun.

apps.name: CORD:EX MAGIAS
apps.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelite where your hand is the puzzle. Weave your cards into Cores and unleash combo attacks. Explore a 2.5D world and meet every telegraphed strike head-on until it BREAKs. When hearts resonate, strike as one with up to five companions and face the truth at the end of five tales.

apps.name: Coremine Corp
apps.short_description: Welcome to CoreMine Corp. Your job here is to set up production chains, manage your electricity, juggle contracts and stock-up while upgrading your factory. Time to prove your worth.

apps.name: CORN!
apps.short_description: Shuck corn to buy tools, buy tools to shuck corn. It couldn’t be more simple! Fend off wasps, children, bears, and Mean Gary! Stay inside the garage, you never know what’s waiting outside for you. Uncover all the secrets that this corn holds.

apps.name: Cosmic Inferno
apps.short_description: Explore 100 star systems, battle pirates, trade, mine asteroids, and salvage wrecks. Buy and customize spaceships, upgrade your weapons, and chart your own course. Your onboard computer A.R.E.S. is always by your side. Whether you like it or not.

apps.name: Cosminomy
apps.short_description: The colorful universe of Cosminomy offers unique colony building challenges on nice little planets. Form thriving settlements, develop them step by step, turn a profit, and expand your colony across the cosmos.

apps.name: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers
apps.short_description: Lead the Musketeers in this steampunk tactical cRPG! Tactical pause combat against the English invasion. Use the powerful Campaign Editor to create and share your own adventures. And play the official campaign and those from the community.

apps.name: Crack of Strike
apps.short_description: Crack open rocks and collect gems in a pixel-art workshop. Pick stones from visiting traders, control each strike, and take an early offer or keep cracking. Stash your finds, cut gems, craft jewelry and build lasting skills. Pay off your debt, and you can become your own boss.

apps.name: CronoPunk
apps.short_description:
Help Crass get through every level using his awesome ability to clone himself.

Cronopunk mixes skill, brainpower, and creativity into a fun, bite-sized adventure that definitely won't leave you unbothered.

apps.name: Crooked Derby
apps.short_description: Bet on one horse. Tell everyone you backed another. Crooked Derby is a party game of secret bets and public lies: rig the race with face-up cards, call your rivals’ bluffs, and get away with it. Play with friends online or solo against lying bots

apps.name: Crown & Spores
apps.short_description: Medieval CO-OP simulator where you grow magical plants, brew potions, create illegal products, trade with customers, and build your own underground empire in a fantasy world.

apps.name: Crypt Survivor
apps.short_description: Fight through a cursed crypt in this action roguelite. Master unique classes, combine powerful upgrades, and claim the abilities of fallen bosses. Battle across five deadly floors to break the curse, or push your build to its limit in Endless Mode.

apps.name: Cube Arena
apps.short_description: A PvP arena fighter to play with or against your friends, on PC and VR. Fight with swords or magic, burn and bomb each other, and outplay the other team across multiple game modes.

apps.name: Cubic Blitz
apps.short_description: Cubic Blitz is an isometric puzzle game where you control a cube and solve loads of hand-crafted levels. With the power of paint, sponges, and much more, your task is simple: PAINT THE WORLD.

apps.name: Cubicle Farter
apps.short_description: Make the Spirit of the Bathroom proud by angering co-workers with skilled flatulence! Cubicle Farter is a humorous adventure centered around corporate culture. Lower productivity in the office with your cheeky output and defeat managers to progress through the building.

apps.name: Cyber Rail
apps.short_description: Cyber Rail is a frenetic roguelike FPS with robot cowboys, speedy parkour, and devastating synergies.  Grapple, slide, and swing as you hunt down enemy bandits on your flying train.

apps.name: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
apps.short_description: Manage a high-stakes logistics depot where the hardest route to navigate is the human one. Negotiate ruthless contracts with e-shops, handle headstrong couriers on the brink of strikes, and build a delivery empire in a gritty management sim where every personality has a price.

apps.name: Dadi Kingdom
apps.short_description: Action RPG: You're the king. Everyone wants something from you, and you've got a sword. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse. Father an heir before your time runs out.

apps.name: Dark Workshop Simulator
apps.short_description: A first-person dark fantasy shop simulator where the customers bite. Stock shelves, set prices and let the grime build up. Trace sigils to brew potions and forge blades, ride out plagues and wars that upend the market, and keep a hammer under the counter.

apps.name: DarkPath
apps.short_description: DarkPath is a roguelike action game where every run brings new challenges. Explore procedurally generated maps, fight randomized enemies, collect powerful items, and shape your build. Discover mysterious objects, encounters, and rewards as you venture deeper into the dark paths of DarkPath

apps.name: Darts Player Simulator
apps.short_description: The most immersive darts career simulation ever made. Build your player, design your darts and rise from pub opens to the World Championship. Handle the press, win over sponsors and take on more than 2,000 players in a living world of tours, rankings and rivalries.

apps.name: Darts RPG
apps.short_description: An RPG set in northern England. Play darts. Aim high. Win the league. Save yourself from total destitution, one lukewarm pint at a time.

apps.name: Death Casino
apps.short_description: DEATH CASINO is an adrenaline-pumping blend of tabletop strategy and Russian Roulette. Duel the deranged Glassman in an ever-escalating battle of speed and wit, where each round brings in more mayhem and strategy to master. Shoot, stab, and drink your way out of the Death Casino!

apps.name: Debt of Souls
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op horror extraction game where your crew owes The Reckoning a debt in souls. Break into cursed buildings, grab anything of value, outrun whatever’s hunting you and get back to the van alive. Dying goes on your tab. So does leaving a friend behind. So does leaving your arm.

apps.name: DecoGear Dimensions
apps.short_description: A challenging & fast paced SINGLE PLAYER arcade-style beat 'em up!

apps.name: Desecrated Deck
apps.short_description: Desecrated Deck is a first-person psychological horror card game where you face a spectral opponent in a forbidden occult ritual of Rock, Paper, Scissors, powerful Item Cards, and supernatural Perks. Win the game — or discover what happens when you don’t.

apps.name: Desktop Buddy
apps.short_description: Desktop buddy is an active sandbox companion game where you can paint, shoot, crush and decorate your very own ragdoll on your desktop. Use familiar paint tools to fully customize your desktop buddy to your liking so you can treat it well, or don't.

apps.name: Desktop Car Dealer
apps.short_description: A tiny used-car lot that lives right above your taskbar. Buy junkers, fix them up, haggle with customers and sell. Make smart calls, hire staff, and turn a run-down roadside lot into a dealership that runs itself.

apps.name: DesktopDaily
apps.short_description: Ami Koharune and Tsukuyomi-chan live on your PC. Chat with voiced characters whose gestures match their words, or watch them cook, read and sleep in a shared home that doubles as a live wallpaper. Free to download, with trial credits for chat.

apps.name: Destiny Is Dice
apps.short_description:
A dungeon of chaos determined by a few dice rolls.
The only one you can rely on here is Grin, the witch who rules the all of this place.
She’ll gladly rig the dice for you. Use this to create options that never existed before and build the strongest team!
Until, one day, you no longer need her help.

apps.name: Devil inc.
apps.short_description: Devil inc. is a strategy simulation of the conflict between good and evil. Explore the development of civilizations, society’s weaknesses and the consequences of your decisions. Watch how your choices change the world.

apps.name: Devil's Work
apps.short_description: Do the Devil's dirty work by harvesting souls for the underworld as you fight to survive enemy hordes in this first-person shooter.

apps.name: Dice of Babel
apps.short_description: A dice roguelike in an endless Library. Roll, play poker-style figures, stack over 200 items and outlast obsessed bosses who bend the rules, climbing the Tower hexagon by hexagon. Solo or co-op for up to 4. Each hexagon asks. Each throw answers.

apps.name: Dice Roll Society
apps.short_description: The dice crafting roguelite where every roll scores. Build your scoring machine and craft five dice face by face. Beat bosses and steal their dice before your rolls run out.

apps.name: Digital Paintball Redux
apps.short_description: A return to form for Digital Paintball with upgraded textures, sounds, menus, maps and more! This is the definitive way to experience the mod that captivated an entire community of Paintball enthusiasts.

apps.name: Dino Haven
apps.short_description: Cozy up with prehistoric pals!  Give them snacks and food to keep them happy! All while you create a stunning safe haven for them to thrive in!

apps.name: Diofru: Survivors of the Tower
apps.short_description: Awaken from a lowly apprentice into one of nine elemental archmages and climb 50 floors of the tower. Kill the epic monster before the floor's clock hits zero, or the ceiling comes down while you fight. Reroll and banish your level-ups, and grow the village below the tower between climbs.

apps.name: Dirt Trackin' 3
apps.short_description: Dirt Trackin’ 3 brings American dirt oval racing to PC with sliding, door-to-door short track action, multiple car classes, custom paint, career racing, multiplayer, and ongoing development shaped by a passionate dirt racing community.

apps.name: Diventare Premier
apps.short_description: Italian-style satirical visual novel. You play Maddalena: 26, boundless political ambition and an arrhythmic heart that won't cooperate. Every choice counts, in a Brianza of favours, aperitivi and late trains. Build your career while trying not to die of a heart attack.

apps.name: Donbas Deadlock: War of Attrition
apps.short_description: Take command in Donbas Deadlock, a tactical card battler inspired by modern warfare. Build you card collection, Deploy a wide variety of units, combine unique abilities and game mechanics to outsmart your opponents. This is the new, next level highly animated strategy card game. Play Now!

apps.name: Donut
apps.short_description: A quick, cheeky trick-taking card game. Everyone starts with points and races to zero by winning tricks, but finish a hand without a single trick and you eat a donut: five points back on. Play bots, a six-venue campaign, or friends online with a party code.

apps.name: DOTARIX
apps.short_description: Make your way through levels packed with traps and puzzles, put your reflexes and wits to the test, and take on increasingly difficult challenges.

apps.name: Dr Dick Dong: Stripper Underworld
apps.short_description: DRDD: Dr Dick Dong is an adult action RPG. Go deep undercover as Dixon Hard, hunting a lost agent through a city drenched in satire, with street brawls, B-movie cheese, X-rated hookups, and a phone you can doomscroll on instead of doing your job.

apps.name: Dragon Riddler
apps.short_description: This is not a word game. It’s a heroic fantasy adventure powered by dynamic word‑based systems that blend the adventurer’s abilities with the player’s skill.

apps.name: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles
apps.short_description: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles is a male-oriented xianxia romance adventure game. Explore the martial world, meet unique female cultivators, grow stronger through cultivation, unlock character stories and intimate interactions, and embark on a journey of dual cultivation.

apps.name: Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow
apps.short_description: The mystical Egyptian underworld beckons you in Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow! Foil the plans of Set and Apep using your powers of light. Explore the varied environments of the underworld and battle your way through in this epic pixel art style Metroidvania.

apps.name: Dungeon Town Life
apps.short_description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Home! A cozy 3D anime dungeon crawler with village life. Fight through dungeons by day, then return to forge weapons, grow healing herbs, brew potions and decorate your home. Play solo or with friends.

apps.name: DUNK
apps.short_description: A first-person 1-6 player basketball game where every physics-based pass, block, and DUNK comes down to skill. Hit unique courts across the universe, hang out over proximity chat, or finesse your 1st-person skills in solo play. Unlock new looks, emotes, and more, to flex on your mates!

apps.name: Dyeversion
apps.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

apps.name: Echoes From The Past
apps.short_description: Return to your childhood home. In this psychological first-person horror game, a cassette recorder brings past events back to life through sound—and changes the present. Follow the echoes, solve puzzles, and uncover a family secret buried long ago.

apps.name: Echoes In Static
apps.short_description: This is an animatronic horror experience where machines are superior and humans are inferior.

apps.name: EDEN FRONTIER
apps.short_description: Lead crash survivors on a hostile planet in this survival colony builder. Secure oxygen, water, food and power. Research new technology, send expeditions and face your residents' demands. Every resource—and every decision—shapes the home you build.

apps.name: Egg Souls
apps.short_description: Nobody believed in the egg. Can you prove that it will reach the nest?

apps.name: EmbeRogue
apps.short_description: EmbeRogue is a real roguelike: turn-based, grid-based and boom-based, where everything can burn. Make your escape or tame your inner flames to defeat the FireLords.

apps.name: Embral
apps.short_description: A roguelike bullet heaven about an elephant defending a sacred tree from a forest fire. Aim, dodge enemy attacks, and upgrade your elephant after every wave.

apps.name: Encirclement: WW2
apps.short_description: A minimalist and approachable grand strategy game combined with pixelated top-down RTS. Encircle the enemy and watch each individual soldier fight!

apps.name: END OF BACK WORLD
apps.short_description:
END OF BACK WORLD is a Bishojo TPS action game based on the SCP worldview.
You must kill mutants in the backroom and cleanse the city.
Survive through combat training and weapon modification with items obtained from the back room.

apps.name: Enhance Defence
apps.short_description: Defend your core against relentless robot swarms in a retro pixel-art auto-battler tower defence. Spawn weapons, gamble on high-risk enhancements, adapt your economy, and survive escalating waves and bosses across five unlockable sectors.

apps.name: Epic Loads: A Hero's Wish
apps.short_description: Spend a jolly day with Prince Hiro, and help him prepare for the holiday festivities!

apps.name: Epsilon Aurigae
apps.short_description: Stranded in a nebula with a broken hyperdrive. Interact with peculiar creatures that call this corner of the galaxy their home in order to trade for items and ultimately get the parts that you need to fix your ship.

apps.name: Erectoria
apps.short_description: Fight sexy bosses, build your Breeder, and unlock adult scenes in this fantasy RPG. Explore islands, solve puzzles, and collect nude boss photos for your private gallery. Combat and pleasure await. Adults 18+ only!

apps.name: Esports Career Simulator 2027
apps.short_description: A deep esports career simulator: from a day job and training at your PC to tournaments, transfers, sponsors and the title of world champion. Choose your discipline, level up your skills, make tough decisions and build your own team.

apps.name: Eurekas
apps.short_description: Eurekas is a real-time strategy colony sim where settlers battle a hostile, mystical island. Build, survive, use magic, and appease your gods—or risk losing everything to the wild forces that resist your claim.

apps.name: Exit Protocol: Emergency
apps.short_description: You are trapped in a looping hospital corridor. The rules are simple: Turn back if you see an anomaly. Close your eyes if you hear a sound. Do not move if you see an entity. Find the exit.

apps.name: F-2 MISSIONS: CASE ONE
apps.short_description: A physics-based flight sim with authentic handling: the JASDF's F-2 over a true-to-scale Japan. As a rookie on a special course, train from takeoffs to valley runs, formation, refueling and US carrier traps, then fly alert scrambles and ops training against simulated SAMs. On a monitor or in VR.

apps.name: Fakeouts
apps.short_description: Fakeouts is a chaotic asymmetric multiplayer game where plush toys hide among an AI-controlled crowd and tear the place apart while Security hunts them down. Switch bodies, blend in, break objectives, rescue captured Puppets or catch and secure every last toy before everything falls apart.

apps.name: Fallen Starborn
apps.short_description: Star creatures, fallen to Earth like shooting stars, together with their Lupine Lord, Vehord. They bring destruction and suffering wherever they go. Join your team of Moonlit Travelers, explore the Underground and face the Lupine Lord in a deadly battle that will decide the fate of the world.

apps.name: Family X Project
apps.short_description: A 2D crossover fighter where every match is yours to shape. Pick a fighter, a style and a sub-mode, then brawl up to four players at once: local, ranked online 1v1 and 2v2, an arcade ladder, a survival run solo or co-op, and Training with every tool you need.

apps.name: Fateful Bullet
apps.short_description: A third-person anime arena shooter where you can bring a sword to a gunfight. Wall-jump across the city, dash through the crossfire and win with a blade or a bullet. Build your own cute fighter and take on real players in fast online PvP.

apps.name: Fear, But Stupid
apps.short_description: A first-person horror game with dark humor and PS2-style vibes. Solve puzzles, find keys and clues, avoid enemies, and escape each level using only your flashlight and your wits. Short but intense experiences with gore, parody, and pure tension.

apps.name: Festival Fireworks Simulator
apps.short_description: Whenever you want fireworks, the night sky is ready. Click to launch a burst, write a wish across the sky, or build a whole show from the very first shell. Holidays, birthdays and ordinary evenings all deserve a fireworks show.

apps.name: Feudal Fall
apps.short_description: The king burned your village to the ground. Raise your capital on its ashes, keep your people alive through the winters and muster armies hundreds strong. Bring down the lords of the feudal pyramid one by one, then lay siege to the king's own city. A real-time city builder and siege strategy game.

apps.name: Fever Tilt
